summary:
Status: complete — proposal grounded in code, no files touched, no cargo run.

1-sentence: Move Normal 720→800 with a taller pill clearance plus test-threshold recalibration, since the suite's two regressions are real geometry effects, not brittle asserts.

Mechanism confirmations:
- Pill overlap: `place` drops the text to PILL_CLEAR only when `narrow && text_right > pill-left` (`src/views/editor/layout.rs:1476-1478`); PILL_CLEAR is 48 (`src/views/editor/mod.rs:180`) but the pill group bottom is 53px in an 860 window, so text starts 5px under the buttons — matches `window.rs:497` failure. Widening the column makes the Rail 860 case narrow more often / text_right larger, tripping it.
- Table wrap: `set_wide(Wide::Column)` + `below > top+px(30)` (`src/shell/tests/end_to_end/md_tables.rs:176`); a wider text column shortens wrap distance (fewer/shorter visual lines), shrinking `below-top` below 30.

Numbered file:line change list:
1. `src/ui/theme.rs:50` — `Page::Normal` base 720→800; `src/ui/theme.rs:531-532` — test to `px(800)` / `px(1600)`.
2. `src/views/editor/mod.rs:180` — `PILL_CLEAR px(48)→px(56)` (covers 53px pill bottom + shadow; check `render.rs:434-444` pill height if 56 still tight at ui>1).
3. `src/views/editor/mod.rs:181,489-490` — `MAX_WIDTH px(720)→px(800)` (default width/room init; live width already dynamic via `layout.rs:778` `min(t.page.measure)`).
4. `src/shell/tests/window.rs:480` — `MAX_WIDTH + px(48)` narrow gate re-derive at 800 (threshold becomes 848); asserts `:482` (Split) and `:497` (Rail, `top==px(40)` strip path in `render.rs:17,739`) keep logic, only trip points move.
5. `src/shell/tests/end_to_end/md_tables.rs:176` — lower `px(30)` to measured value (expect ~15-25) or lengthen `long` filler; then recalibrate dependent offsets `:178-185` (`start+80`, `start+40`, click `start+140±1`) from the new wrap.
6. Leave alone (shell chrome, not measure-tied): `boards.rs:84,90,103` (`width-65,height-31`), `cursors_comments.rs:79` corner clicks, `:126-138` pane≥199/comments 270/172 — re-verify only.

Fonts/interaction: body lh 1.7 (`layout.rs:1111`), H1 30 (`layout.rs:1086`) orthogonal to measure; only effect is wrap calibration at default size 16 — no style change needed.

Risks: PILL_CLEAR 56 may still be short at ui 1.5 zoom (pill scales via `t.px`, clearance fixed px) — consider `max(PILL_CLEAR, strip)` already there; phone widths 320/420 unaffected (already narrow). `blocks.rs:97-140` long-tag wrap (`at+90` click) may shift with 800 — watch, don't pre-edit.

Re-verify run: `cargo test window_buttons_leave_the_header_and_the_title_clear`, `cargo test page_width_follows_the_text_size`, `cargo test md_tables` (then `boards`, `cursors_comments`, `blocks::tags`), then full `cargo test` suite green before merge.
